products.title: Rare Beauty E-Gift Cards
products.body_html:
Rare Beauty E-Gift Cards can be ordered online and delivered via email to anyone you choose. Select a value from $15 to $100, include your personalized message, and send (you can even schedule sending for a later date). Your e-gift card will be delivered via email and will include a unique code for your recipient to enter at checkout. You’ll also receive a notification when your E-Gift Card has been delivered and opened. It’s that easy.

 

*E-Gift Cards are only valid in the U.S. Final sale and non-refundable.
